meta.source: Vendors' public status pages (Statuspage JSON format)
meta.license: NOT VERIFIED. No licence stated by the vendors or Atlassian; only derived counts and dates are kept, each with a link to the vendor's page. Not redistributed.
meta.attribution: Incident counts derived by TrustFit from each vendor's own public status page (linked).
meta.status: not collected: run the ingest script to fill this file
meta.matching: Candidate status hosts in src/orgs.ts; a page is kept only if its URL is on the organization's domain or its name contains the organization's name.
meta.note: Incidents a vendor itself posted in the 90 days before the check. Vendors differ in what they post: a long list can mean a candid vendor, a short one a quiet vendor. The feed returns about 50 recent incidents, so a busy page may have more than shown (windowCovered false).
